keys.title: System Configuration
keys.description: Manage local-first engine parameters and hardware links.
keys.syncDesc: Synchronize Merkle-Tries with local mesh peers.
keys.audioRetentionDesc: Persist audio files locally after transcription.
keys.jitsiBaaDesc2: and cannot be toggled off. Telehealth calls route
keys.jitsiBaaDesc3: to a self-hosted Jitsi server you configure below — never the public meet.jit.si. Each call also requires an explicit BAA acknowledgement on the Telehealth screen. These guarantees are non-optional by design.
keys.highContrastDesc: Force maximum contrast for field readability.
keys.showTickerDesc: Scrolling status bar at the top of the app.
keys.scrollSpeedDesc: Seconds per loop — lower is faster.
keys.noMessagesDesc: No messages — the ticker is hidden until you add one.
keys.telehealthDesc: Your self-hosted Jitsi domain. Telehealth routes only here — there is no public fallback. If this is empty, telehealth calls are disabled.
keys.telehealthDisabled: ✗ No server configured — telehealth is disabled.
keys.killSwitchDesc: Designate a USB token. If it is removed while armed, all vault keys are dropped from memory (references cleared; reclaimed by the runtime).
keys.noDevicesPrefix: No devices listed yet. Plug in your token and click
keys.backupDesc: Exports encrypted ciphertext only, HMAC-signed with your passphrase. Restore verifies the signature and refuses tampered files.
keys.auditLogDesc: Hash-chained record of every vault access (metadata only — no PHI). Editing or deleting any past entry breaks the chain.
keys.tamperingDetectedPrefix: ✗ TAMPERING DETECTED — chain breaks at entry #
keys.nukeDesc: Irreversibly delete all local storage and keys.
